question: Ustad Zakir Hussain is one of the greatest exponents of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tabla.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain is a renowned Indian tabla player** and **percussionist.**
 
• He has collaborated with various musicians from different genres and countries, including George Harrison and Mickey Hart.
 
• The tabla is a pair of small drums used in Indian classical music.
 
• It consists of two drums, the smaller one is called the dayan and the larger one is called the bayan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shehnai is a wind instrument used in Indian classical music.
 
 
• **It has a double reed and is played with the lips, similar to a western oboe.**
 
 
 
• Violin is a stringed instrument played with a bow.
 
 
• **It is used in various genres of music, including classical, jazz, and folk.** 
 
 
 
• Sitar is a stringed instrument used in Indian classical music.
 
 
• **It has a long neck and a round body with strings that are plucked with a plectrum.**
